## Why this matters
PR #398 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `FEATURE_ROMAN_COACH_REVIEWED_AT` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P2)** `POST /coach/clients/:client_id/check-ins/:check_in_id/reviewed` has no explicit `@Throttle` or metadata pin — `src/check-ins/coach-check-ins.controller.ts:45-51` — fix: add route-level `@Throttle({ default: { ttl: 60_000, limit: 60 } })` or named bucket; add metadata test asserting exact throttle values
- [ ] **F2 (P2)** `markReviewedByCoach` returns raw Prisma `CheckIn` row with no `select` and no Zod `.strict()` envelope — `src/check-ins/check-ins.service.ts:363-373` — fix: add strict response schema `{ id, reviewedByCoach, coachReviewedAt }` and parse through `Zod.strict()` before returning
- [ ] **F3 (P2)** Non-atomic find-then-update — ownership not reasserted in write, no `P2025` collapse — `src/check-ins/check-ins.service.ts:363-384` — fix: replace two-step pattern with atomic scoped write: `update({ where: { id: checkInId, coach_id: coachId }, ... })` with `P2025` → `NotFoundException`, or `updateMany` with count-zero → `NotFoundException`
- [ ] **F4 (P3)** No sub-coach attribution test for the `ConversationReview` marker — `test/messaging.service.spec.ts:335-399` — fix: add a sub-coach test that seeds a sub-coach relationship, calls `markReadByCoach(subCoachId, clientId)`, and asserts `ConversationReview.coach_id` is the head coach id
- [ ] **F5 (P3)** No telemetry register/emit for coach-reviewed surface (`coach.check_in_reviewed`, `coach.thread_review_stamped`, `client.competence_pill_read`) — `src/check-ins/check-ins.service.ts`, `src/messaging/messaging.service.ts` — fix: register event names, emit them at real call sites with id/timestamp payloads only

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
